J., he used to say, ‘formerly (the Lord was) was with him’ (allusion to <cite ref="I Chronicles 9:20">I Chr. IX, 20</cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:10:7">Y. Meg. I, 72ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>למקנתרה</he>.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:4:10">Y. Maasr. III, end, 51ᵃ</cite> <he>מְקַנְתֵּר לאילין וכ׳</he> chided those teachers of the Agadoth, and called the latter charm-books.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:4:5">Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הוי היא דו מקנתר לון</he> (not <cite ref="E00857"><he>הרי</he></cite>) it is this for which he chides them (<cite ref="I Samuel 2:29">I Sam. II, 29</cite>); a. e.
